select_opposite: Select the opposite-side controls matching the current selection.
add_opposite: Add the opposite-side controls to the current selection.
copy_opposite: Copy the selected controls' current values to their opposite-side controls.
Saved mirror exceptions are applied per channel.
mirror: Mirror the selected controls to their opposite-side equivalents.
Mirror exceptions can be configured per rig and are saved for reuse.
to_right: Copy current mirrored values from selected left-side controls to their right-side opposites.
Invert exceptions multiply saved channels by -1 before writing them to the opposite control.
to_left: Copy current mirrored values from selected right-side controls to their left-side opposites.
Invert exceptions multiply saved channels by -1 before writing them to the opposite control.
all_keys: Copy all keyed animation from selected controls to their opposite-side controls.
Existing keys on the destination channels are replaced, and mirror exceptions are applied per channel.
add_invert: Save an Invert exception for the selected controls and Channel Box attributes.
The saved channel value is multiplied by -1 during mirror operations.
add_keep: Save a Keep exception for the selected controls and Channel Box attributes.
The saved channel value transfers unchanged during mirror operations.
remove_exception: Remove saved mirror exceptions from the selected controls and Channel Box attributes.
